name: sage300-assistant
description: Sage 300 (Accpac) ERP assistant: verified T-SQL from AOM data dictionaries, version/upgrade guidance and release notes, and C# against the ACCPAC.Advantage .NET library.
author: fdtaljaard

name: sage200-assistant
description: Sage 200 Evolution (Pastel Evolution) ERP assistant: C# development against the Pastel.Evolution .NET SDK — connecting via DatabaseContext, the record load/set/Save() pattern, posting transactions, and generating correct code from a bundled class and enum reference extracted from the shipped SDK CHM. More capabilities to follow.
author: fdtaljaard

name: sapb1-assistant
description: SAP Business One (B1) ERP assistant: object type number, table and primary key lookup from a bundled list of all B1 object types, verified SQL views/queries from bundled B1 10.0 and 9.3 data dictionaries, C# development against the DI API from a bundled DI API 10.0 class and enum reference, and Service Layer (REST / OData v4) integration guidance including SQLQueries and FP 2602 webhooks. More capabilities to follow.
author: fdtaljaard

name: sagex3-assistant
description: Sage X3 ERP assistant: verified SQL views/queries and table/field lookup from a bundled Sage X3 V11 table dictionary (tables, abbreviations, keys, columns, data types, local-menu enum values and foreign-key link expressions) compiled from Sage's online help; versions and upgrades (V12 release/patch naming and lifecycle, platform prerequisites per release, upgrade paths and procedures, per-release notes 2023 R2 to 2026 R1 with tables touched). More capabilities to follow.
author: fdtaljaard

name: acumatica-assistant
description: Acumatica ERP assistant: REST integration development against the contract-based REST API from a bundled extraction of Acumatica's Integration Development Guide (2026 R2) — sign-in and OAuth 2.0/OIDC, endpoint and contract versions, JSON record shape, query parameters per contract version, CRUD, actions and long-running operations, custom fields, files, license limits, push notifications and webhooks, with a catalogue of 187 documented example requests, and exact entity, field and action names from a snapshot of the Default/25.200.001 contract (2025 R2). More capabilities to follow.
author: fdtaljaard
